title: Implement Planner that freezes structured PlanSpec
purpose: Build the planning layer that converts operator intent into a reviewable frozen plan without producing side effects.
scope: Implement Planner trait with draft_plan, validate_plan, freeze_plan, and explain_plan.
Use ModelBroker only for structured plan drafting and summaries.
Validate all planned tools through ToolRouter before the plan can freeze.
Annotate each step with risk hints and required verification, but leave final risk classification to PolicyEvaluator.
Reject plans with unknown tools, raw shell commands, missing verification rules, missing rollback requirements for writes, or direct secret values.
Emit IntentReceived and PlanFrozen audit events only after successful validation.
deliverables: Unit tests for allowed and rejected plans
acceptance_criteria: A service recovery intent produces a frozen plan with diagnostic steps and a gated restart step.
Planner cannot freeze a plan containing shell.exec or unknown tools.
Planner cannot freeze a write step without rollback requirement.
PlanFrozen appears in audit before any EffectPrepared for that run.
Freezing the same deterministic plan produces the same plan hash.
verification: Inspect audit order for IntentReceived, PlanFrozen, and absence of EffectPrepared during planning.
Attempt malformed, unknown-tool, raw-shell, and secret-containing plans.
Snapshot-test the frozen nginx recovery plan.
risk_notes: Planner output must stay reviewable; it must not be treated as permission.
implementation_steps: Define Planner trait with draft_plan, validate_plan, freeze_plan, and explain_plan operations.
Consume only IntentCtx, bounded runtime context, and ModelBroker structured output.
Validate every tool name and normalized parameter shape through the semantic tool manifest.
Validate dependency graph, retry budget, approval requirement, verification rule, rollback requirement, and success criteria.
Reject shell.exec, unknown tools, direct secret content, and writes without rollback requirements.
Emit IntentReceived and PlanFrozen only after successful validation and stable freeze hash computation.
failure_modes: Planner executes or prepares an effect during planning.
Planner risk hint downgrades a high-risk policy class.
Cycle, missing dependency, unknown tool, or missing verification freezes successfully.
Frozen plan mutates without hash change.
PlanFrozen appears after EffectPrepared for the same run.

verification_matrix.expected: allowed, rejected, hash, audit-order, and service recovery plan tests pass
IntentReceived and PlanFrozen are emitted without EffectPrepared
ToolRouter, policy, and safety tests remain green

blocked_until: Invalid tools and secret-like content fail closed.
